                           Ministry of Home Affairs

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of Ministry
of Home Affairs during the month of July, 2026.

1.   Hon’ble President of India assented to the following bills in the Month of July,
     2026:
     (i) On 17.07.2026 - Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Bill, 2026.
     (ii) On 30.07.2026 - Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of
          Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply
          and Distribution) (Telangana Amendment) Bill, 2024.

2.   Notification regarding extension of “Punjab Right to Business Act, 2020” to UT of
     Chandigarh, has been published in Gazette of India (Extraordinary) vide S.O.
     3604 (E) dated 02.07.2026.

3.   In the month of July, 2026, Notifications regarding promulgation of the following
     regulations have been published in Gazette of India (Extraordinary):
     (i) Vide Notification No. 23 dated 28.07.2026 - “the Lakshadweep Town and
         Country Planning and Development Regulation, 2026”.
     (ii) Vide Notification No. 24 dated 28.07.2026 - “the Andaman and Nicobar
          Islands Town and Country Planning (Amendment) Regulation, 2026”.

4.   The Union Cabinet has approved the followings proposals in the month of July,
     2026:
     (i) On 01.07.2026 - Agreement between the Govt. of India and the Government
         of Republic of Belarus on Mutual Protection of Classified Information.
     (ii) On 22.07.2026 - Agreement between the Govt. of India and the Govt. of the
          Republic of Cuba on Cooperation for Combating the Illicit Traffic in Narcotic
          Drugs, Psychotropic Substances, Precursors and their related offences.

5.   On 11.07.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired two important meetings
     i.e., (i) The Second Meeting of the Apex Committee for New Central Sector
     Scheme for Industrial Development of Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and
     (ii) Review of various issues related to the State of West Bengal.


                                      Page 1 of 5
6.   The Hon'ble Union Home Minister chaired review meetings in West Bengal on
     18.07.2026 and 19.07.2026 to assess the overall law and order situation in the
     State and review the progress of implementation of the Nyaya Sanhitas.

7.   Union Home Secretary chaired the following important meetings in the month of
     July, 2026:
     (i) On 01.07.2026 - A Security review meeting with concerned stakeholders to
           review preparedness of Shri Amarnath ji Yatra, 2026.
     (ii) On 07.07.2026 - A high-level meeting to deliberate on strategies for reducing
           pendency in courts, with emphasis on leveraging digital interventions and
           improving coordination across the criminal justice system.
     (iii) On 08.07.2026 - 23rd National Level Meeting between India and Myanmar in
           New Delhi, India to further strengthen cooperation for the mutual benefit of
           the two countries.

8.   A brainstorming session on the implementation of the Nyaya Sanhitas was
     chaired by the Union Home Secretary on 06.07.2026 to review implementation
     issues and identify measures for effective operationalisation of the new criminal
     laws.

9.   In July,2026, a major breakthrough was made in LWE operations when Misir
     Besra, the last remaining CPI (M) Polit Bureau Member/Central Committee
     Member, was apprehended along with 04 other LWE cadres from Dhanbad-
     Giridih area. With this arrest, the entire top Naxal leadership has been neutralised
     (total 41 PBM/CCM neutralised since 2014). In view of the above, the LWE
     scenario was reviewed by MHA and West Singhbhum has been upgraded from
     ‘District of Concern’ to ‘Legacy & Thrust’ category. Now, all 38 SRE districts have
     been placed in the Legacy & Thrust category.

10. On 04.07.2026, taking significant steps under 'Zero Tolerance Policy' against
    terrorism, 23 more individuals have been declared as 'terrorists'.


11. On 09.07.2026, the Ministry of Home Affairs, through a consolidated order,
    specified the official versions of the National Song, ‘Vande Mataram’, and the
    National Anthem, ‘Jana Gana Mana’, along with the occasions on which they are
    to be sung/played. It also clarified that, in any programme where both the National
    Song and the National Anthem are to be sung/played, the National Song shall be
    sung/played first, followed by the National Anthem. Further, the ‘Prevention of
    Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026’ has been passed in the Rajya
                                       Page 2 of 5
     Sabha on 29th July 2026 and in the Lok Sabha on 30th July 2026, to accord legal
     protection to the National Song ‘Vande Mataram’ under the ‘Prevention of Insults
     to National Honour Act, 1971’, on par with the Constitution of India, the National
     Flag, and the National Anthem ‘Jana Gana Mana’.


12. On 12.07.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister launched the "Mission 70 Lakh
    Plantation" campaign in New Delhi and laid the foundation stones for various
    Delhi Government projects.


13. On 13.07.2026, 185 acres of land were made available to the Border Security
    Force (BSF) to further strengthen security arrangements along the India–
    Bangladesh border. Subsequently, on 15.07.2026, the Government of West
    Bengal allocated more than 1,000 acres of land across nine border districts of
    the State for the construction of fencing along the India–Bangladesh international
    border to the BSF.


14. Introduced e-Group Visit Visa (Cruise) to foreign tourists coming to India by cruise
    vessels, which follows a fixed and predetermined itinerary.


15. The Criminal Procedure Identification (CrPI) System was further strengthened
    through integration with the e-Forensics system for retrieval of DNA reports,
    onboarding of Investigating Officers for biometric matching operations, and
    migration of legacy criminal records from States into the national biometric
    database.

16. Under ICJS 2.0, financial assistance was approved and allocated to Bihar,
    Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Mizoram, Sikkim,
    Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal, while proposals from several other
    States/UTs remained under examination.

17. Significant progress was made towards strengthening interoperability among
    Criminal Justice System stakeholders through technical support for e-
    Prosecution APIs, CCTNS-CFSL integration, Charge Sheet PDF integration, API
    testing utilities and resolution of State-specific integration issues in coordination
    with NIC-MHA.




                                       Page 3 of 5
18. A review meeting was held with the Deputy Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh and
    senior State officials to discuss implementation of ICJS and the New Criminal
    Laws, further strengthening Centre-State coordination.

19. During the Month of July, 2026, several disasters and disaster like situations were
    faced in various parts of the country mainly due to floods, flash floods, lightning,
    landslide etc. MHA’s Integrated Control Room for Emergency Response (ICR-
    ER) maintained round the clock vigil and disseminated 235 red colour alerts, 581
    orange colour alerts received from IMD, 28 red colour alerts and 138 orange
    colour alerts received from CWC, 06 red colour and 18 orange alerts received
    from INCOIS and 45 landslide alerts received from GSI; to concerned States and
    Districts for early warning, response and evacuation.


20. Two Inter Ministerial Central Teams (IMCTs) were sent during the month for the
    State of Assam to do on the spot assessment of damage due to floods.


21. Meeting of Sub-Committee of National Executive Committee (SC-NEC) on 30th
    July 2026 to consider the report of IMCT on damage caused by flash flood/flood,
    landslides and cloudburst of 2025 in Assam Maharashtra and Uttarakhand.

जुलाई, 2026 के दौरान गृह मंत्रालय की प्रमुख उपलब्धियां, महत्वपूर्ण विकास और महत्वपूर्ण
घटनाक्रम।
1.   भारत की माननीय राष्ट्रपतत ने जुलाई, 2026 में तनम्नतलखित तिधेयक ं क मं जूरी दी:

     (i)     दिन ं क 17.07.2026 क - महाराष्ट्र धातमि क स्वतं त्रता तिधेयक, 2026

     (ii)    दिन ं क 30.07.2026 क - तसगरे ट और अन्य तं बाकू उत्पाद (तिज्ञापन तनषेध और व्यापार
             एवं िातिज्य, उत्पादन, आपूतति और तितरि का तितनयमन) (तेलंगाना संश धन) तिधे यक,
             2024


2.   स .आ. 3604 (E) तदनां क 02.07.2026 के माध्यम से चंडीगढ़ संघ र ज्य क्षेत्र में "पंजाब

     व्यिसाय का अतधकार अतधतनयम, 2020" के तिस्तार के संबंध में भारत के राजपत्र

     (असाधारि) में अतधसूचना प्रकातशत की गई ।


3.   जुल ई, 2026 में तनम्नतलखित तितनयम ं के प्रख्यापन के संबंध में भारत के राजपत्र (असाधारि)

     में अतधसूचना प्रकातशत की गई :
     (i) अतधसूचना संख्या 23 तदनां क 28.07.2026 के माध्यम से - "लक्षद्वीप नगर एवं ग्र मीण

            योजन एवं दवक स दवदनयमन, 2026”

     (ii) अतधसूचना संख्या 24 तदनां क 28.07.2026 के माध्यम से - "अंडमान और तनक बार द्वीप

            समूह नगर एवं ग्र मीण योजन एवं दवक स दवदनयमन, 2026”


4.   केंद्रीय मंतत्रमंडल ने जुलाई, 2026 में तनम्नतलखित प्रस्ताि ं क मंजूरी दी :

     (i) दिन ं क 01.07.2026 क - भारत सरकार और बे लारूस गिराज्य की सरकार के बीच
            िगीकृत जानकारी के पारस्पररक संरक्षि संबंधी समझौता।

     (ii) दिन ं क 22.07.2026 क - भारत सरकार और क्यू बा गिराज्य की सरकार के बीच नशीली
            दिाओं, मनः प्रभ वी पि र्थों, उसके उत्प्रेरकों की अिैध तस्करी और उससे संबंतधत

            अपराध ं से दनपटने के तलए सहय ग समझौता।

                                            पष्ृ ठ 6 का 1
5.   दिन ं क 11.07.2026 को म ननीय केन्द्रीय गृ ह मंत्री महोिय ने िो महत्वपूणण बै ठकों की
     अध्यक्षत की, (i) केंद्रीय श दसत प्रिे श जम्मू और कश्मीर के औद्योदगक दवक स के दलए नई
     केन्द्रीय क्षेत्र योजन हे तु शीर्ण सदमदत की िू सरी बै ठक, और (ii) पदिम बंग ल र ज्य से संबंदधत
     दवदभन्न मुद्ों की समीक्ष बैठक I



6.   माननीय केंद्रीय गृ ह मंत्री महोिय ने पदिम बं ग ल र ज्य में समग्र कानून और व्यिस्था की खस्थतत

     का आकलन करने और न्याय संतहताओं के कायाि न्वयन की प्रगतत की समीक्षा करने के तलए

     दिन ं क 18.07.2026 और 19.07.2026 क पतिम बंगाल में समीक्षा बैठकों की अध्यक्षता की।


7.   केंद्रीय गृह सदिव महोिय ने जुल ई, 2026 के महीने में दनम्नदलखित महत्वपूणण बै ठकों की

     अध्यक्षत की:

       (i)   दिन ं क 01.07.2026 को - श्री अमरन र्थ जी य त्र , 2026 की तैय ररयों की समीक्ष के

             दलए संबंदधत दहतध रकों के स र्थ सुरक्ष बै ठक।

       (ii) दिन ं क 07.07.2026 को - अि लतों में लंदबत म मलों को कम करने की रणनीदतयों पर
             दवि र-दवमशण करने के दलए एक उच्च-स्तरीय बैठक दजसमें दिदजटल उप यों के

             इस्तेम ल और आपर दधक न्य य प्रण ली में आपसी त लमेल को बे हतर बन ने पर जोर

             दिय गय ।

     (iii)   दिन ं क 08.07.2026 को - भ रत और म् ं म र के बीि प रस्पररक ल भ के दलए सहयोग
             को और मजबूत करने के दलए 23वीं र ष्ट्र स्तरीय बै ठक।


8.    नए आपर दधक क नूनों के प्रभ वी दिय न्वयन के दलए आवश्यक उप यों की पहि न तर्थ
      क य ण न्वयन से संबंदधत मुद्ों की समीक्ष हे तु केंद्रीय गृह सदिव महोिय द्वर दिन ं क
      06.07.2026 को एक दवि र-दवमशण सत्र की अध्यक्षत की गई।



9.    जुल ई, 2026 में, व मपंर्थी उग्रव ि अदभय नों में एक बडी सफलत दमली जब CPI (M) पोदलत

      ब्यूरो के अंदतम शेर् सिस्य/केंद्रीय सदमदत के सिस्य दमदसर बेसर को धनब ि-दगररिीह क्षेत्र
      से 04 अन्य व मपंर्थी उग्रव िी कैिरों के स र्थ दगरफ्त र दकय गय । इस दगरफ्त री के स र्थ,

      पूरे शीर्ण नक्सली नेतृत्व को सम प्त कर दिय गय है (वर्ण 2014 से कुल 41 PBM/CCM
                                          पष्ृ ठ 6 का 2
     तटस्थ)। उपयुणक्त खस्थदत को िे िते हुए, गृह मंत्र लय द्व र व मपंर्थी उग्रव ि पररदृश्य की

     समीक्ष की गई और पदिम दसंहभूम को 'दिखरर क्ट ऑफ कंसनण ' से 'दवर सत एं ि थ्रर' श्रेणी
     में अपग्रेि दकय गय है । अब, सभी 38 SRE दजलों को दवर सत एं ि थ्रर श्रे णी में रि गय

     है ।


10. दिन ं क 04.07.2026 को आतंकव ि के दवरुद्ध 'शू न्य सदहष्णुत नीदत' के अंतगणत महत्वपूणण

     किम उठ ते हुए 23 और व्यखक्तयों को 'आतंकव िी' घोदर्त दकय गय ।


11. गृह मंत्र लय ने , दिन ं क 09.08.2026 को एक समेदकत आिे श के म ध्यम से, र ष्ट्रगीत ‘वंिे
     म तरम्' तर्थ र ष्ट्रग न ‘जन-गण-मन’ के आदधक ररक संस्करणों एवं इनको ग ए / बज ए ज ने
     व ले अवसरों की सूिी के स र्थ, यह भी स्पष्ट् दकय दक यदि दकसी क यण िम में र ष्ट्रगीत और

     र ष्ट्रग न िोनों क ग यन/ व िन दकय ज त है , तो पहले र ष्ट्रगीत और उसके पि त र ष्ट्रग न

     क ग यन य व िन दकय ज एग । 'र ष्ट्र-गौरव अपम न-दनव रण (संशोधन) दवधेयक 2026'

     के र ज्य सभ में 29 जुल ई 2026 तर्थ लोक सभ में 30 जुल ई 2026 को प ररत हो ज ने से,

     ‘र ष्ट्र-गौरव अपम न-दनव रण अदधदनयम, 1971’ के अंतगणत, र ष्ट्रगीत ‘वंिे म तरम् ’ को, भ रत
     के संदवध न, र ष्ट्र ध्वज तर्थ र ष्ट्रग न ‘जन-गण-मन’ के सम न ही, दवदधक संरक्षण प्र प्त हो

     सकेग ।


12. दिन ं क 12.07.2026 को म ननीय केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री महोिय ने नई दिल्ली में "दमशन 70 ल ि

     पौध रोपण" अदभय न की शुरुआत की और दिल्ली सरक र की दवदभन्न पररयोजन ओं की

     आध रदशल रिी।


13. दिन ं क 13.07.2026 को, भ रत-ब ं ग्ल िे श सीम पर सुरक्ष व्यवस्थ को और मजबूत करने
     के दलए सीम सुरक्ष बल (BSF) को 185 एकड भूदम उपलब्ध कर ई गई। इसके उपर ं त,

     दिन ं क 15.07.2026 को, पदिम बं ग ल सरक र ने भ रत-ब ं ग्ल िे श अंतरर ष्ट्रीय सीम पर
     ब ड लग ने के दलए र ज्य के नौ सीम वती दजलों में 1,000 एकड से अदधक भूदम BSF को
     आवंदटत की।

14. िूज जह जों द्व र भ रत आने व ले दविे शी पयणटकों के दलए ई-ग्रुप दवदजट वीज (िूज) की

     शुरुआत की गई दजसमें दनदित और पूवण दनध ण ररत य त्र क यणिम क प्र वध न दकय गय ।

15. डीएनए ररप टों की पुनप्राि खि के तलए ई-फ रें तसक प्रिाली के साथ एकीकरि, बाय मे तटर क
     तमलान कायों के तलए जां च अतधकाररय ं की ऑनब तडिं ग और राज्य ं से पु र ने आपरातधक
     ररकॉडि के राष्ट्रीय बाय मेतटर क डे टाबेस में अंतरण के माध्यम से आपरातधक प्रतिया पहचान

     (CrPI) प्रिाली क और सुदृढ़ बन य गया।



16. ICJS 2.0 के तहत, तबहार, छत्तीसगढ़, गुजरात, हररयािा, मध्य प्रदे श, तमज रम, तसखिम,
     उत्तरािंड, उत्तर प्रदे श और पतिम बंगाल क तित्तीय सहायता की मंजूरी दी गई और उन्हें
     र दश आबंतटत की गई, जबतक कई अन्य राज्य /ं संघ र ज्य क्षेत्रों के प्रस्ताि ं की जां च की जा

     रही है ।

17. ई-प्रॉतसक्यू शन APIs, CCTNS-CFSL एकीकरि, चाजि शीट पीडीएफ एकीकरि, API

     परीक्षि उपय तगताओं और एनआईसी-गृह मंत्र लय के समन्वय से राज्य-तितशष्ट् एकीकरि

     तजससे केंद्र-राज्य समन्वय क और सुिढ़ बन य जा सके।


19. जुलाई, 2026 के दौरान, दे श के तितभन्न तहस् ं में मुख्य रूप से बाढ़, फ्लै श फ्लि, तबजली

     पडा। गृह मंत्रालय के आपातकालीन क रण व ई के तलए एकीकृत तनयंत्रि कक्ष (ICR-ER) ने

                               Government of India
                            Ministry of Home Affairs
                                       ***

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of Ministry
of Home Affairs during the month of June, 2026.

1. The Hon’ble President of India assented to the following bills in the month of June,
   2026:
    i. On 05.06.2026 - The Puducherry Higher Education Council Bill, 2025 (Bill No.
       14 of 2025).
    ii. On 10.06.2026 - Indian Partnership (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill, 2026.
   iii. On 16.06.2026 - Bihar Civil Courts Bill, 2026.
   iv. On 29.06.2026 - Chhattisgarh Shops and Establishment (Regulation of
       Employment and Condition of Service) (Amendment) Bill, 2025.
    v. On 29.06.2026 - Gujarat Prohibition of Transfer of Immovable Property and
       Provision for Protection of Tenants from Eviction from premises in the
       Disturbed Areas (Amendment) Bill 2026.

 2. In the month of June, 2026 following Notifications were published in Gazette of
    India (Extraordinary):
    i. Vide Notification No. 20 dated 02.06.2026 - Promulgation of "The Dadra and
        Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu Fire and Emergency Service Regulation,
        2026".
    ii. Vide Notification No.22 dated 05.06.2026 - Promulgation of the “The
        Lakshadweep Excise Regulation, 2026”.
   iii. Vide S.O. 3457(E)) dated 25.06.2026 - Delegation of powers to all UTs under
        the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against Safety of Civil Aviation Act, 1982
        (66 of 1982).

3. Hon’ble Union Home Minister launched Foreign Contribution Regulation Act 2.0
   (FCRA 2.0) Portal and Electronic-Overseas Citizen of India (e-OCI) Registration
   system on 30.06.2026. The FCRA 2.0 will mark a major technological
   transformation of the FCRA ecosystem through complete portal revamp, cloud
   migration and business process re-engineering. Similarly, the e-OCI Card system
   has been started in lieu of physical OCI booklet system.
                                      Page 1 of 4
4. Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired following meetings in the month of June,
    2026:
     i. On 08.06.2026 - A review meeting in Delhi on the issue of Yamuna
        Rejuvenation.
    ii. On 04.06.2026 - 73rd Plenary Session of North Eastern Council (NEC) in
        Shillong, Meghalaya.
  iii. On 12.06.2026 - A security review meeting in New Delhi to assess the
        preparations for the Shri Amarnath Ji Yatra 2026.
   iv. On 16.06.2026 - An important meeting in New Delhi where consensus was
        reached on the long-pending Kishau Multipurpose Dam Project for the
        rejuvenation of the Yamuna River.
    v. On 26.06.2026 – 10th Apex Level Meeting of the Narco-Coordination Centre
        (NCORD) in New Delhi unveiling ‘Vision Document on Drug Control (2026-
        2029).
   vi. On 29.06.2026 – An Urban Flood Risk Management Program meeting.

5. Hon’ble Union Home Minister inaugurated Land Port Management System
   (VINIMAY) in New Delhi on 09.06.2026.

6. A Tripartite MOU was signed on 11.06.2026 between Government of India, Assam
   and Nagaland for facilitating mineral oil operations in the Assam - Nagaland
   boundary areas.

7. Agreement signed between the Govt. of the Republic of India and Govt. of the
   Republic of Cuba on Cooperation for Combating the Illicit Trafficking in Narcotic
   Drugs, Psychotropic Substance, Precursors and Related offences.

8. A meeting chaired by the Union Home Secretary with the Chief Secretary, DGP and
   Home Secretary of West Bengal was held on 09.06.2026 to review the
   implementation of the Nyaya Sanhitas and other criminal justice reforms. NCRB
   also undertook field visits and technical engagements to support the rollout of e-
   Sakshya, CCTNS and other ICJS initiatives in the State.

9.   ICJS 2.0 implementation progressed with approval and allocation of fund to Andhra
     Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal, while proposals from several
     other States/UTs remained under examination.

10. Significant progress was made towards strengthening interoperability across
    Criminal Justice System pillars through integration of e-Forensics 2.0, e-Prosecution

                                      Page 2 of 4
    2.0, CCTNS, and other applications. Technical improvements, API optimisation,
    dashboard reconciliation and State-specific support were also undertaken to
    facilitate seamless data exchange.

11. Exhibitions on the Nyaya Sanhitas were organised in Meghalaya, Gujarat and
    Puducherry to promote awareness and facilitate effective implementation.

12. The 26th All India Fingerprint Conference was organised at NCRB
    Headquarters on 19.06.2026, where the Hon'ble Union Home Minister
    inaugurated the Criminal Procedure Identification (CrPI) System, NAFIS
    Mobile App (Abhigyan), e-Forensics 2.0 and e-Prosecution 2.0, marking a
    significant milestone in technology-enabled policing and criminal justice
    administration.

13. CCTNS 2.0 implementation advanced through pilot rollout reviews and
    integration initiatives with Mission Vatsalya, NDAL-ALIS (Arms Licence
    System), VAHAN, NCRP/Samanvya and other national platforms,
    strengthening inter-agency data sharing and service delivery.

14. The Criminal Procedure Identification (CrPI) System became operational across all
    36 States/UTs and Central Law Enforcement Agencies, with over 6 lakh
    arrested/convicted persons enrolled. Top-performing States and agencies were
    recognised for exemplary implementation.


15. Major national digital crime platforms, including NAFIS, CriMAC, National
    Database of Sexual Offenders (NDSO), National Integrated Database on
    Arrested Narco Offenders (NIDAAN), ITSSO and National Crime Records Check
    (NCRC), continued to expand, enhancing crime investigation, inter-State
    coordination and digital policing.

16. Citizen-centric digital policing services available through the Central Citizen
    Services Portal, including Missing Person Search, Vehicle NOC, Proclaimed
    Offenders Information and the Nearest Police Station Mobile App, continued to
    witness increased public utilisation.



                                    Page 3 of 4
17. NCRB conducted extensive capacity-building programmes, including national-
    level trainings, webinars and workshops on CCTNS, ICJS, CrPI and NAFIS for
    police personnel, fingerprint experts and other stakeholders, supporting nationwide
    adoption of digital policing initiatives.


18. Parakram Padak were awarded to the 03 police personnel of states/UTs and CAPF’s/
    CPOs during the period from 1st June, 2026 to 30th June, 2026.


19. On 20.06.2026, Union Home Secretary chaired the following meetings in Srinagar,
     Jammu and Kashmir :
     i. To review security situation of Jammu and Kashmir.
    ii. SANJY, 2026 - To review preparedness of Shri Amarnath ji Yatra, 2026. In the
        meeting, concerned stakeholders were directed to take necessary action for
        conducting holy yatra successfully.
   iii. To review issuance of Arms licenses in UT of J&K.

20.   Navi Mumbai International Airport has been declared an authorized immigration
      check post effective from 29.06.2026, and the e-Visa facility has also been
      implemented there.

21.   Haldia and Karaikal have been declared as authorized immigration check posts
      with effect from 22.06.2026 adn 23.06.2026, respectively. The e-Visa facility has
      been implemented at Haldioa and Karaikal with effect from 24.06.2026.

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of Ministry
of Home Affairs during the month of May, 2026.

 1.   During an important high-level meeting held on 10.05.2026 in New Delhi,
      Hon’ble Union Home Minister reviewed country's preparedness to deal with
      potential floods and heat waves in a comprehensive manner.

 2.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired a meeting held on 18.05.2026 in
      Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh to review the left-wing extremism, and also to inaugurate
      the Shaheed Veer Gundadhur Seva Dera Jan Suvidha Kendra in Jagdalpur.

 3.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister also chaired the High Level 26 th Central Zonal
      Council meeting held on 19.05.2026 in Jagdalpur, which was attended by the
      Chief Ministers of Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and
      Uttarakhand, along with senior officials from these member states and the Central
      Government.

 4.   On 27.05.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired a high-level security
      review meeting in Bikaner, Rajasthan to comprehensively assess security-related
      issues concerning the border districts along the India-Pakistan Border (IPB).

 5.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister virtually inaugurated women’s barracks at the
      Sanchu Post of the Border Security Force (BSF) on 26.05.2026 and also
      inaugurated two border outposts – G-7 and G-13; in Bhuj, Gujarat, on 29.05.2026.

 6.   On 30.05.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired a security review meeting
      in Bhuj, Gujarat, focusing on security-related issues concerning the border and
      coastal districts of Gujarat situated along the India-Pakistan Border (IPB).

 7.   Bilateral Ministerial level meeting with General Luong Tam Quang, Minister of
      Public Security of Vietnam and GoI Delegation led by Minister of State for Home
      Affairs (Mr. Bandi Sanjay Kumar) was held on 06.05.2026.

 8.   Following meetings were held by Union Home Secretary during the month of
      May 2026 :
                                      Page 1 of 5
     (a) On 07.05.2026, meeting on ‘deliberation of Urban Flood Risk Management
         proposal of Ahmedabad under Urban Flood Risks Management Programme
         Phase-III.
     (b) On 08.05.2026, meeting with High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to India.
     (c) On 13.05.2026, meeting regarding various issues pertaining to Nagaland.

9.   The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), under Operation WHITE STRIKE,
     uncovered a large transnational cocaine trafficking syndicate and seized
     approximately 349 kilograms of high-grade cocaine valued at nearly ₹1,745 crore
     in the illicit market from Mumbai and adjoining logistics corridor.

10. Annual Conference of Relief Commissioners/Secretaries Department of Disaster
    Management of States/UTs to review the state of preparedness for South-West
    Monsoon 2026- on 2nd May 2026 at NIDM, Rohini, New Delhi.

11. The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), under Operation RAGEPILL,unearthed an
    international drug syndicate involved in the trafficking of Captagon, leading to
    the seizure of approximately 227.7 Kgs. of Captagon Tablets/Powder and the
    arrest of one overstaying Syrian national, who is a member of the syndicate.

12. The field operations for the Houselisting and Housing Census (HLO) under Phase
    I of Census 2027 commenced in five States and Union Territories namely
    Rajasthan, Meghalaya, Maharashtra, Jharkhand and Municipal Corporation of
    Delhi (MCD) area in Delhi NCT as part of the ongoing nationwide Census
    exercise.

13. On 7.05.2026, Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG & CCI)
    flagged off six awareness vans from Janganana Bhawan, New Delhi, as part of
    the Census 2027 public outreach campaign in Delhi NCT for the ongoing first
    phase of Census 2027, i.e., Houselisting and Housing Census (HLO).

14. Department related Parliamentary Standing Committee on Home Affairs visited
    Jammu, Srinagar, Gulmarg, Sonmarg and Kargil from 11.05.2026 to 16.05.2026
    for onspot assessment of Disaster Preparedness at Mata Vaishno Devi Temple,
    onspot assessment of Security Situtation at the tourist place, Interacted with
    representatives of J&K Police regarding law & order, Assessed Border Security
    establishment & also interacted with respresentatives of Indian Army.

    to strengthen collaboration in combating cyber-enabled financial frauds and
    curtailing mule accounts across the banking and digital payments ecosystem.

                                 Government of India
                              Ministry of Home Affairs
                                         ***

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of Ministry of
Home Affairs during the month of April, 2026.

1.    On 02.04.2026, the Delhi Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026 (Bill
No. 02 of 2026) has been assented by the Hon’ble President of India. The Bill amends the
following eight Acts:
      (i)    Delhi Industrial Development, Operation and Maintenance Act, 2010;
      (ii) Delhi Shops and Establishments Act, 1954;
      (iii) Delhi Electricity Reforms Act, 2000;
      (iv) National Capital Territory of Delhi (Incredible India) Bed and Breakfast
             Establishment (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2007;
      (v) Delhi Agricultural Produce Marketing (Regulation) Act, 1998;
      (vi) Delhi Water Board Act, 1998;
      (vii) Delhi Professional Colleges or Instituions (Prohibition of Capitation Fee,
             Regulation of Admission, Fixation of Non-Exploitative Fee and Other
             Measures to Ensure Equity and Excellence)Act, 2007;
      (viii) Delhi Diploma Level Technical Education Institutions (Prohibition of
             Capitation Fee, Regulation of Admission, Fixation of Non-Exploitative Fee
             and other Measures to Ensure Equity and Excellence) Act, 2007.

2.    On 17.04.2026, the Hon’ble President of India assented to the “The Madhya
Pradesh Madhyastham Adhikaran (Sanshodhan) Vidheyak, 2025”.

3.     On 09.04.2026, a meeting of High-Level Committee (HLC) was held under the
chairmanship of Hon’ble Union Home Minister to consider the proposals for grant of
additional assistance from National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) for Flash
Flood/Flood, landslides and Cyclone storm “Montha” of 2025 in Karnataka, Telangana
and Sikkim.

4.     The following meetings were held by Union Home Secretary in the month of April,
2026 :

                                       Page 1 of 7
      (i)     On 02.04.2026, deliberation on comprehensive proposal comprising all 03
              phases of earthquake mitigation programme and traditional knowledge of
              seismic science.

      (ii)    On 02.04.2026, a meeting for effectiveness of SACHET platform and
              reorientation of SACHET.

      (iii)   On 09.04.2026, a meeting to discuss the exposition of the Holy Relics of
              Lord Buddha in the UT of Ladakh,

      (iv)    On 18.04.2026, a meeting with concerned stakeholders to review
              preparedness of Shri Amarnathji Yatra, 2026. In the meeting, concerned
              stakeholders were directed to take necessary action for conducting holy yatra
              successfully.

      (v)     On 27.04.2026, a meeting to review the security situation in Manipur.

5.      The Census 2027, world's largest census exercise has begun. The Government of
India has commenced Phase-I of Census 2027 - House listing and Housing Census (HLO)
from 01.04.2026, marking the beginning of the country’s largest administrative and
statistical exercise. This is India’s first ever digital data capture and Self-Enumeration.
The national enumeration exercise was initiated with the enumeration of the Hon’ble
President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, through the option of Self-Enumeration,
upholding the proud tradition of commencing the national count with the First Citizen of
India.

6.    In view of the prevailing situation in the Gulf region, the Visa/ e-Visa and waive
of overstay penalty to foreigners stuck in India has been extended for a further period of
two months, beyond 06.04.2026.

7.     At present, no district is affected with Left Wing Extremism (LWE). The 38
districts covered under the Security Related Expenditure Scheme (SRE) have been
classified into the following two categories as on 08.04.2026: -

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of Ministry of
Home Affairs during the month of March, 2026.

1.    The Hon’ble President of India assented to the Himachal Pradesh Ceiling on Land
Holdings (Amendment) Bill, 2024 on 12.03.2026.

2.     On 25.03.2026, the Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Immigration,
Visa, Foreigners Registration & Tracking (IVFRT) Scheme beyond 31st March, 2026 for
a period of five year from 1st April, 2026 to 31st March, 2031 with budget outlay of ₹1800
crore.

3.     On 13.03.2026, a High-Level Committee (HLC), under the Chairmanship of
Hon’ble Union Home Minister, approved Rs. 1,912.99 crore of additional Central
assistance from National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) to a number of states affected
by flood, flash flood, cloudburst, cyclone ‘Montha’ landslides during year 2025.

4.     Hon’ble Union Home Minister soft-launched four digital tools and formally
unveiled the mascots – “Pragati” (female) and “Vikas” (male) for Census-2027 in New
Delhi.

5.    A meeting regarding activities of insurgent groups in Nagaland and of Indian
Insurgent Groups (IIGs) in Myanmar was held on 28.03.2026 under the chairmanship of
Union Home Minister.

6.     A meeting under the chairmanship of the Hon’ble Union Home Minister was held
on 31st March 2026 to review NCRB’s Annual Statistical Reports, namely Crime in India-
2024, Accidental Deaths & Suicides in India-2024, and Prison Statistics-2024.

7.    Union Home Secretary chaired the following meetings in the month of March,
2026:
       (i)  On 09.03.2026, a meeting with the Registrars General of the High Courts
            of Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab & Haryana, Allahabad,
                                        Page 1 of 4
              Calcutta, and Madras, along with Central Project Coordinators, Additional
              Secretaries (Home), Secretaries (Law), and Directors General of Police of
              the concerned States/UTs, to discuss the pending notification of Draft
              Model Rules.
        (ii) On 19.03.2026, meeting of Sub-Committee of National Executive
              Committee (SC-NEC) to consider the financial assistance for Tamil Nadu,
              Himachal Pradesh, Uttrakhand, Punjab, Telangana and Tripura.
        (iii) On 23.03.2026, meeting of Sub-Committee of National Executive
              Committee (SC-NEC) to consider the report of IMCT on damage caused
              by Flash Flood/Flood, Landslides and Cyclone storm 'Montha' of 2025 in
              Karnataka, Telangana and Sikkim.
        (iv) On 23.03.2026, a meeting with the Chief Secretary and other senior officer
              of Jharkhand Government to review the implementation of Naveen Nyaya
              Sanhitas in the State.
        (v) On 23.03.2026, a meeting to review security of the tourist spot both open
              and closed, etc. in Jammu and Kashmir.
        (vi) On 24.03.2026, a meeting of Standing Finance Committee (SFC) for
              appraisal of the proposal of the Govt. of Manipur regarding creation of
              community assets in resettled villages/ habitations of IDPs in Manipur.
        (vii) On 30.03.2026, meeting for Review of Model Home Guard Bill.

8.     The Left Wing Extremism affected district covered under Security Related
Expenditure (SRE) scheme have been reviewed. As on date, there are no LWE affected
district in the country and hence SRE districts will have two categories only i.e. (i) District
of Concern-01 No. and (ii) Legacy & Thrust (L&T) Districts - 37 Nos.

9.   Exhibitions on Nyaya Sanhitas were held in Odisha and Uttarakhand on 6th and 7th
March 2026, respectively.

10. A special meeting of SRE Standing Committee was held on 05.03.2026 under the
chairmanship of Special Secretary (Internal Security) to consider the claims of the Govt.
of Manipur.

11. Keeping in view the ongoing conflict in the Gulf region which resulted in
disruption of international travel, Ministry of Home affairs on 06.03.2026, has decided to
extend the Visa / e-Visa for 30 days on gratis basis and to waive of overstay penalty for
foreigners stuck in India.
                                          Page 2 of 4
12. For strengthening India’s internal security framework, Rashtriya Raksha
University (RRU) and the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) Academy, along with its training
establishments, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on 21.03.2026 to
affiliate and accredit specialized security courses.

13. On 30.03.2026, Ministry of Home Affairs issued revised modalities for the
issuance of Regular Tourist Visa to the nationals of People’s Republic of China, China-
SAR Hongkong and China-SAR Macau, whereby, requisite amendment, in visa
conditions for Buddhist pilgrims & family members of Chinese diplomats, has been

Grant Agreement up to December 31, 2030.

Islands under Grant No. 49 of the MHA in the Revenue (Voted) section for pre-investment
activity of GNI project for the financial year 2025-26.

of Uttarakhand, Bihar, Goa, Meghalaya and Odisha on 30.03.2026.

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of
Ministry of Home Affairs during the month of February, 2026.

1.   The following Bills have been assented by the Hon’ble President of India :

     (i)   On 19.02.2026, Delhi Court Fee Amendment Bill, 2026.

     (ii) On 23.02.2026, Delhi Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Bill,
          2026.

2.   The Union Cabinet approved renaming Kerala to 'Keralam' in February
     2026.

3.   On 08.02.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister chaired a security review
     meeting on Left Wing Extremism (LWE) in Raipur, Chhattisgarh and a
     review meeting regarding various development works in Chhattisgarh.

4.   On 20.02.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister, launched Vibrant Villages
     Programme–II (VVP–II), at a cost of ₹6,839 crore, in Nathanpur village of
     Assam.

5.   On 21.02.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister laid the foundation stone of
     the headquarters of 10th Battalion of the Assam Police in Kamrup, Assam.

6.   On 24.02.2026, Hon'ble Union Home Minister chaired a review meeting on
     assistance to States, for natural calamities.

7.   On 26.02.2026, Hon’ble Union Home Minister interacted with personnel of
     the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) in Araria, Bihar, and inaugurated the
     Border Out Posts at Leti and Inderwa, along with e-inaugurating and laying
     the e-foundation stones for various SSB projects.
                                   Page 1 of 4
8.    In the month of February, the following meetings were convened by Union
      Home Secretary :

      (i) On 03.02.2026, with the Registrar Generals of the High Court of
          Manipur and Meghalaya

      (ii) On 05.02.2026, with the Registrar General of High Court of Gujarat.

      (iii) On 23.02.2026, with the e-Committee of the Supreme Court, on the
            integration of ICJS and CIS.

9.    Exhibition on the Naveen Nyaya Sanhita was organised in the UTs of
      Lakshadweep and DD&DNH to create awareness about the new laws.

10.   A demonstration of Nyaya Shruti application was held for e-Committee on
      20.02.2026 and for Secretary (Justice) on 26.02.2026.


11.   In the Month of February, 2026, following Notifications have been published
      in the Gazette of India (Extraordinary) :

      i)    notification No. 4 dated 20.02.2026 regarding promulgation of the “The
            Lakshadweep Marine Fisheries Regulation, 2026”.

      ii)   Notification No. 5 dated 20.02.2026 regarding promulgation of the
            “The Lakshadweep (Registration Amendment) Regulation, 2026”

12.   A tripartite agreement was signed between Govt. of India, Govt. of
      Nagaland and representatives of Eastern Nagaland Peoples’ Organisation
      (ENPO), an apex body representing eight recognized Naga tribes of the six
      eastern districts of Nagaland, on 05.02.2026 in New Delhi. As per
      agreement, a Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority (FNTA) shall be
      created for Eastern Nagaland Region with legislative, executive and
      financial autonomy within the State of Nagaland to fulfil social, political,
      economic, educational, cultural and linguistic aspirations of people of the
      Eastern Nagaland Region.
                                     Page 2 of 4

      (SC-NEC) were held under the Chairmanship of Union Home Secretary:-

      (i)     Meeting on 11.02.2026 to consider the proposal of central financial
              assistance for Andhra Pradesh from the Recovery & Reconstruction
              funding window under National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF);

      (ii)    Meeting on 13.02.2026 to consider the project proposals (PPRs) of
              all 10 States viz. Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Chhattisgarh,
              Maharashtra, Kerala, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Odisha, Uttarakhand and
              Tamil Nadu.

      (iii)   Meeting on 19.02.2026 to consider the proposals of Mitigation
              measures to prevent Erosion in respect of Arunachal Pradesh for
              financial assistance from the earmarked allocation under NDMF fund.

14.   Agreement between the Govt. of the Republic of India and the Govt. of
      Nepal on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters was signed on
      17.02.2026.

15.   Vide Gazette Notification / S.O. No. 941(E), dated 20.02.2026, a State-
      Level Empowered Committee has been constituted under the chairmanship
      of the Deputy Registrar General, Directorate of Census Operations, West
      Bengal, for the purpose of processing and disposing of the large number of
      citizenship applications received under the CAA in the State of West
      Bengal.

      on prevention, detection, imposing restriction on movement and deportation

17.   Jogbani Land immigration post has been designated as an authorized IPs

Major Achievements, significant Development and important events of
Ministry of Home Affairs during the month of January, 2026.

1.   The Hon’ble President of India assented to the “The Registration (Tamil
     Nadu Amendment) Bill, 2025” on 09.01.2026.
2. Hon’ble Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah inaugurated/laid the
   foundation stone for the following projects:
     (i)   On 03.01.2026, Development projects worth ₹373 crore of the
           Andaman and Nicobar Administration at Sri Vijaya Puram.
     (ii) On 09.01.2026, National IED Data Management System (NIDMS) of
          the National Security Guard (NSG) in New Delhi through video
          conferencing.
     (iii) On 13.01.2026, BSL-4 Bio-Containment Facility of the Gujarat
           Biotechnology Research Centre in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
     (iv) On 30.01.2026, New building of the Assam Legislative Assembly in
          Dibrugarh, along with the ground-breaking and inauguration of 5
          projects at a total cost of approximately ₹1,715 crore.
3.   Following meetings were held under the Chairmanship of Union Home
     Secretary:
     (i)   On 13.01.2026- A Meeting of Sub-Committee of National Executive
           (SE-NEC) to consider the National Earthquake Risk Mitigation
           Program.
     (ii) On 22.01.2026- A Meeting for Sub-Committee of National Executive
          committee (SC-NEC) to consider the report of IMCT on damage caused
          by Flash flood/flood, landslides and cyclonic storm “Montha” of 2025 in
          Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Nagaland
          and UT of Jammu & Kashmir.

4.   In the Month of January, 2026, following Notifications have been published
     in the Gazette of India (Extraordinary):

                                    Page 1 of 3
     (i)    Notification No. 26(E) dated 02.01.2026 for delegation of powers to all
            UTs under the Industrial Relation Code, 2020.
     (ii)   Notification No. 27(E) dated 02.01.2026 for delegation of powers to all
            UTs under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions
            Code, 2020 (37 of 2020).
     (iii) Notification No. 21(E) dated 02.01.2026 under sub-section (1) of
           section 46A of “Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act,
           1991 (1 of 1991), regarding appointed date i.e. the 9th day of January
           2026, as the date on which all other public moneys received by or on
           behalf of LG shall be credited to a Public Account entitled “The Public
           Account of the Capital”.
     (iv) Notification No. 256(E) dated 16.01.2026 for delegation of powers to
          UTs of Lakshadweep, Chandigarh and DHN&DD, Puducherry and J&K
          under the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisement)
          Act, 1954 (21 of 1954).
5.   On 03.01.2026, an exhibition on the Naveen Nyaya Sanhita was organized
     in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to create awareness about the new
     laws.

6.   On 22.1.2026, the ongoing joint operation by the CRPF and Jharkhand
     Police in West Singhbhum achieved a major success in anti-Naxal
     operation with killing of 'Anal alias Patiram Manjhi', a notorious Naxalite
     Central Committee member carrying a reward of ₹1 crore, and 15 other
     Naxalites.

7.   On 23.1.2026, the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar
     Award for the year 2026 has been conferred upon Lieutenant Colonel Seeta
     Ashok Shelke in Individual Category and Sikkim State Disaster
     Management Authority in the Institutional Category.

8.   The 6th edition of Khelo India Winter Games 2026 has been successfully
     held in Leh from 20th to 26th January, 2026 with the participation of 21 teams
     and 438 players from 18 states/ UTs. The event highlighted Ladakh’s
     growing recognition as a major winter sports destination in India.


                                      Page 2 of 3
9.   On the occasion of Republic Day 2026, a total of 982 Personnel of Police,
     Fire, Home Guard & Civil Defence (HG&CD) and Correctional Services
     were awarded Gallantry and Service Medals. Out of 982 Medals, 125
     Medals for Gallantry (GM), 101 President Medals for Distinguished Service
     (PSM) and 756 Medals for Meritorious Service (MSM) were awarded.

10. On 25.01.2026, the President of India approved the conferment of Jeevan
    Raksha Padak Series of Awards - 2025 on 30 persons which includes
    Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak to 06, Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak to 06
    and Jeevan Raksha Padak to 18 persons.

11. Padma Awards 2026 were announced on 25.01.2026. The list comprises 5
    Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri Awards. 19 of
    the awardees are women, 6 persons are from the category of Foreigners/
    NRI/ PIO/ OCI and 16 Posthumous awardees.

12. During the month of January, 2026, “Parakram Padak” was awarded to 01
    police personnel of CAPF.

     (iv) अतधसूर्ना संख्या 256(ई) तिनां क 16.01.2026- और्तध एिं जािु ई उपर्ार

6.   तिनां क 22.1.2026 को पतिमी तसंहभूम में सीआरपीएफ और झारिंड पुतलस के

8.   िेलो इं तडया शीतकालीन िेल 2026 का छठा संस्करण 18 राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों

docs.title: Monthly Major Achievements of MHA, December 2025
pages:
Major Achievements, significant Development and important
events of Ministry of Home Affairs for the month of December, 2025.

    The Hon’ble President of India assented to the following bills in the
month of December:
 i.   On 10.12.2025- “The Maharashtra Special Public Security Bill,
      2024” & “The Indian Stamp (Madhya Pradesh Second Amendment)
      Bill, 2025”.

ii.   On 15.12.2025- “The Haryana Prohibition of Change of Public
      Utilities Bill, 2022”.

2.   The Union Cabinet, has approved the proposal for conducting
Census of India 2027 at a cost of Rs.11,718.24 crore through digital
means. The Census process is being managed and monitored through a
dedicated portal.

3.   On 24.12.2025, the Union Cabinet approved the proposal of the
signing of Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty (MLAT) in Criminal Matters
between India and Nepal.

4.   The Cabinet has approved the following cabinet notes in December,
2025:
  i. Signing and Ratification of the Agreement between the Government
     of India and the Government of Nepal on Mutual Legal Assistance
     in Criminal Matters.
 ii. Transfer of 0.773 Acres land of BSF Battalion Headquarter,
     Rambagh, Gandhidham (Gujarat) to Gujarat State Urban
     Development Company Limited (A Government of Gujarat
     Undertaking).
iii. Promulgation of the Lakshadweep (Indian Stamp Amendment)
     Regulation, 2025 under the article 240 of the Constitution.
iv. Extension of time limit prescribed to submit report to the Central
     Government by the Commission of Inquiry set-up to inquire into
     the causes and associated factors of the crisis and the unfortunate
     incidents of violence that took place in the state of Manipur on
     03.05.23 and afterwards.

5.   Following meetings were chaired by Hon’ble Union Home Minister
in the month of December:
  i. On 15.12.2025- A High Level Committee (HLC) which approved the
     proposal of National Project for Strengthening Community Based
     Disaster Risk Reduction Initiatives in Panchayati Raj Institutions
     in 20 States for grant of financial assistance from National Disaster
     Mitigation Fund (NDMF) with a financial outlay of Rs 507.367
     Crore.
ii.   On 19.12.2025- A meeting for the constitution of a dedicated body,
      the Bureau of Port Security (BoPS), for the security of vessels and
      port facilities.

6.   A meeting was held under the chairmanship of Union Home
Secretary on 15.12.2025 for discussion and finalization of Drone and
Anti-Drone items proposed by High Power Committee (HPC) of CAPFs for
formulation of Mod Plan-V.

7.   Treaty between the Republic of India and the Republic of Cuba on
Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters was ratified by Indian side
on 24.12.2025.

8.   On 19.12.2025, a meeting for Sub-Committee of National Executive
Committee (SC-NEC) was held under the Chairmanship of Union Home
Secretary to consider the proposal under Mitigation Scheme for Forest
Fire Risk Management from National Disaster Mitigation Fund.

9.   The India–UK Criminal Records Sharing (CRS) Memorandum of
Understanding was signed between the Governments of India and the
United Kingdom on 15.12.2025.

10. Notification regarding extension of the Punjab Shops and
Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2025 (Punjab Act No. 12
of 2025) to the UT of Chandigarh vide S.O. 5647 (E) dated 05.12.2025.

11. Notification regarding promulgation of the “the Lakshadweep
(Indian Stamp Amendment) Regulation, 2025” has been published in
Gazette of India (Extraordinary) vide Notification No. 65 dated
26.12.2025.

Major Achievements, significant Development and important
events of Ministry of Home Affairs for the month of November, 2025.

     The Hon’ble President of India assented to the following bills in the
month of November:
  i. On 06.11.2025 - “The Chhattisgarh Labour Laws Amendment and
     Miscellaneous Provisions Bill, 2025”and “The Indian Stamp
     (Chhattisgarh Amendment) Bill, 2023”.
 ii. On 08.11.2025 - “The Factories (Madhya Pradesh Amendment) Bill,
     2025.
iii. On 14.11.2025 - “The Maharashtra Lokayukta Bill, 2022”.
iv. On 18.11.2025 –
       a. “The Factories (Tripura Second Amendment) Bill, 2025”.
       b. “The Factories (Tripura Second Amendment) Bill, 2025”.
       c. “The Factories (Bihar Amendment) Bill, 2025”.
       d. “The Madhya Pradesh Labour Laws (Amendment) and
          Miscellaneous Provisions Bill, 2025”.
       e. “The Factories (Assam Second Amendment) Bill, 2020”.
       f. “The Punjab Regulation of Cattle Feed, Concentrates and
          Mineral Mixtures Bill, 2018”.

2.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah chaired the 32nd
meeting of Northern Zonal Council (NZC) in Faridabad, Haryana on
17.11.2025.

3. Hon’ble Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah inaugurated three-
day 60th DGsP/IGsP Conference in Raipur, Chhattisgarh on
28.11.2025. The country has been facing the problem of Naxalism for
the last 40 years. The DGsP/IGsP Conference has emerged as a forum
that provides solutions for country’s internal security—covering
everything from problem-solving and challenges to strategies and policy
formulation. As a result, the number of Naxal-affected districts has come
down from 126 in 2014 to just 11 today. Before the next DGsP/IGsP
Conference, the country will be completely free from the problem of
Naxalism.

4.   Following meetings were chaired by Union Home Secretary in the
month of November:
  i. On 06.11.2025- A meeting in New Delhi to discuss the issues raised
     by the Hon’ble CM, Nagaland regarding establishment of IIT in
     Nagaland, upgradation of Kohima Medical College and
     establishment of a new incubation city, Nagaki. The meeting was
     attended by Secretary (DoHE), Chief Secretary (Nagaland) and
     other senior officers of Central Ministries/ Departments.
 ii. On 11.11.2025- The meetings in New Delhi to discuss various
     issues concerning the State of Mizoram, including development of
     Lengpui airport in Mizoram and issues related to Ceithu Airport &
     three airstrips in Nagaland. These meetings were attended by Chief
       Secretaries of Mizoram and Nagaland, Secretary (MoDoNER),
       Secretary (MoCA) and other senior officers of Central Ministries/
       Departments.
iii.   On 18.11.2025- A meeting to review the modalities to operate 19
       Seater/Small aircrafts from Kargil Airport in the UT of Ladakh.

5.   The Home Secretary convened meetings with the Registrar
Generals of J&K and Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and
Jharkhand High Courts on 06.11.2025, 20.11.2025, 14.11.2025 and
25.11.2025 respectively.

6.   A one-day National Conference on New Criminal Law in National
Judicial Academy, Bhopal was held from 8th - 9th November, 2025. The
conference was attended by more than 120 Officers from Police,
Prosecution, and Judiciary.

7.   A Treaty between the Republic of India and the Republic of Cuba
on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters was signed on
10.11.2025.

8.    In pursuance of India-Australia Economic Cooperation and Trade
Agreement (ECTA), Ministry of Home Affairs had incorporated provisions
for “Post Study work visa” and “Work and Holiday visa” for Australian
nationals, in Visa Manual, 2019.

9. On 20.11.2025, Vizhinjam (Kerala), Hazira (Gujarat) and Pipabav
(Gujarat) have been declared as an authorised Immigration Posts. The
number of Immigration Check Posts(ICPs) have now gone up from the
existing 114 to 117.

       g) Notification No. 50- The Industrial Disputes (Dadra and Nagar

नक्सिवाद की समस्या का सामना कर रहा है । डीजीएसपी/आईजीएसपी सम्मे िन एक मं च के

नतीजतन, नक्सि प्रभातवत तजि ं की सं ख्या 2014 में 126 से घटकर आज तसफा 11 ह गई है ।

docs.title: Monthly Major Achievements of MHA, October 2025
pages:
Major Achievements, significant Development and important
events of Ministry of Home Affairs for the month of October,
2025.

     The Hon’ble President of India assented to the “The
Factories (Himachal Pradesh Amendment) Bill, 2020” on
07.10.2025.

2.   The instructions of the Hon’ble President for promulgating
“The Industrial Disputes (Gujarat Amendment) Ordinance, 2025”
were conveyed on 28.10.2025.

3.   Following meetings were chaired by Hon’ble Union Home
Minister:
 i.   On 01.10.2025 - A High-Level Committee meeting
      approving a number of mitigation, recovery & reconstruction
      projects for 9 states having total outlay of Rs. 4645.60 crore.
ii.   On 09.10.2025 - A High-level meeting in New Delhi to
      review the security situation in Jammu and Kashmir.

4.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister inaugurated and laid
foundation stone for the following:
  i. On 04.10.2025 - Goa state government’s ‘Mhaje Ghar
     Yojana’ and various development projects.
 ii. On 09.10.2025 - Development projects worth approximately
     ₹1816 crore of the Delhi Government in New Delhi.

5.   Union Home Secretary reviewed the implementation of New
Criminal Laws in Bihar and Uttarakhand on 07.10.2025 and in
Kerala on 10.10.2025.

6.   On 17.10.2025, a review meeting was convened by Union
Home Secretary on implementation of New Criminal Laws in the
Northeastern States.

7.   A meeting under the chairmanship of Union Home Secretary
was held on 15.10.2025 to discuss the report submitted by High
Power Committee (HPC) for formulation of Modernization Plan-V
of CAPFs and action taken on the decision taken in the meeting
held on 21.08.2025.

8.   A decision had been taken to conduct a one-day National
Conference on New Criminal Law in National Judicial Academy,
Bhopal in the Month of November. The conference will be
attended by the Officers from Police, Prosecution, and Judiciary.
9.    HLC approved projects under Expansion and Modernization
of Fire Services for three States viz. Haryana, Madhya Pradesh
and Rajasthan.

10. On 13.10.2025, An MoU was signed between the BOI, MHA
and Mongolian Government to enhance and strengthen
cooperation on immigration matters.

11. The LWE affected district covered under SRE scheme have
been reviewed and now only 11 districts are categorized as LWE
affected districts. Out of 11 districts, 03 are categorized as Most
affected, 04 districts are categorized Districts of concern and 04
are other LWE affected district.

12. Prior approval of Central Government before introduction of
the following Bills in the Legislative Assembly of Puducherry has
been conveyed:

 i.    On 07.10.2025 “The Puducherry Prevention of Anti-Social
       Activities (Amendment) Bill, 2023.
ii.    On 10.10.2025 “The Industrial Disputes (Union Territory of
       Puducherry Amendment) Bill, 2025.
iii.   On 10.10.2025 “The Contract Labour (Regulation and
       Abolition) (Union Territory of Puducherry Amendment) Bill,
       2025.
iv.    On 10.10.2025 “The Factories (Union Territory of
       Puducherry Amendment) Bill, 2025.

          स्तरीय सतमतत की बै ठक।

          तिल्ली में उच्च-स्तरीय बै ठक।

4.        माननीय केंद्रीय िृि मांत्री ने तनम्नतलखखत का उि् घाटन और तशलान्यास तकया:

     i.   तिनाां क 04.10.2025 को - िोिा राज् सरकार की 'माझे घर योजना' और तितभन्न

 ii.      तिनाां क 09.10.2025 को - नई तिल्ली में तिल्ली सरकार की लिभि ₹1816 करोड़
          रुपए की तिकास पररयोजनाएँ ।


5. केंद्रीय गृह सचिव ने तिनाां क 07.10.2025 को तबिार एवं उत्तराखां ड में और तिनाां क
10.10.2025 को केरल में नए आपरातधक कानूनोां के कायाा न्वयन की समीक्षा की।


6. केंद्रीय गृह सचिव द्वारा तिनाां क 17.10.2025 को पूिोत्तर राज्ोां में नए आपरातधक कानूनोां
के कायाा न्वयन की समीक्षा पर बैठक बु लाई िई।

7. तिनाां क 15.10.2025 को केंद्रीय िृि सतचि की अध्यक्षता में केंद्रीय सशस्त्र पुतलस बलोां
(सीएपीएफ) के आधुतनकीकरण हे तु योजना-V तैयार करने के चिए उच्चातधकार प्राि सतमतत
(एचपीसी) द्वारा प्रस्तुत ररपोटा और तिनाां क 21.08.2025 को आयोतजत बैठक में तलए िए
तनणायोां पर की िई कारा िाई पर चचाा िे तु एक बै ठक आयोतजत की िई।
8. राष्ट्रीय न्यातयक अकािमी, भोपाल में नए आपरातधक कानूनोां पर नवंबर में एक तििसीय
राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन आयोतजत करने का तनणाय तलया िया। इस सम्मेलन में पुतलस, अतभयोजन और

न्यायपातलका के अतधकारी भाि लें िे।


9. उच्चातधकार प्राि सतमतत ने तीन राज्ोां नामतः िररयाणा, मध्य प्रिे श और राजथिान के तलए
अतिशमन सेिाओां के तिस्तार और आधुतनकीकरण के अांतिात पररयोजनाओां को मांजूरी िी।


10. आप्रिासन मामलोां पर सियोि बढाने और सुदृढ करने के तलए बीओआई, िृि मांत्रालय
और मांिोतलयाई सरकार के बीच तिनाां क 13.10.2025 को एक समझौता ज्ञापन पर िस्ताक्षर

तकए िए।


11. एसआरई योजना के अांतिात िामपांिी उग्रिाि प्रभातित तजलोां की समीक्षा की िई और 11
तजलोां को िामपांिी उग्रिाि प्रभातित तजलोां के रूप में ििीकृत तकया िया चिसमे से 03 तजलोां

को सिाा तधक प्रभातित, 04 तजलोां को तचां ताजनक तजले और 04 तजलोां को िामपांिी उग्रिाि

प्रभातित अन्य तजलोां के रूप में ििीकृत तकया िया ।


12. पुिुचेरी तिधान सभा में तनम्नतलखखत तिधे यकोां को पेश करने से पूिा केंद्र सरकार की पू िा

स्वीकृतत दी गई:


   i.   तिनाां क 07.10.2025 को पुिुचेरी असामातजक तियाकलाप तनिारण (सांशोधन)
        तिधेयक, 2023।
  ii.   तिनाां क 10.10.2025 को औद्योतिक तििाि (पुिुचेरी सांघ राज् क्षेत्र सां शोधन) तिधेयक,
        2025।
 iii.   तिनाां क 10.10.2025 को ठे का श्रम (तितनयमन एिां उन्मूलन) (पुिुचेरी सांघ राज् क्षेत्र
        सांशोधन) तिधे यक, 2025।
 iv.    तिनाां क 10.10.2025 को कारखाना (पुिुचेरी सांघ राज् क्षे त्र सांशोधन) तिधेयक, 2025।

docs.title: Monthly Major Achievements of MHA, September 2025
pages:
Major Achievements, significant Development and important
events of Ministry of Home Affairs for the month of
September, 2025.

    The Hon’ble President of India assented to the "The
Himachal Pradesh Loktantra Prahri Samman (Repealing) Bill,
2023" on 08.09.2025.

2.   The Hon’ble President of India assented to the “The
Factories (Uttar Pradesh Amendment) Bill, 2024” on 23.09.2025.

3.   The instructions of the Hon’ble President for promulgating
the “The Industrial Disputes (Tripura Third Amendment)
Ordinance, 2025” were conveyed on 30.09.2025.

4.  The Home Secretary reviewed the implementation of New
Criminal Laws for Goa on 26.09.2025.

5.   The Home Secretary convened meetings with Registrar
Generals of 10 High Courts – Allahabad, Bombay, Karnataka,
Kerala, Bihar, Punjab & Haryana, Delhi, Rajasthan, Telangana
and Odisha.

6.    A tripartite Suspension of Operation (SoO) Agreement on
revised ground rules was signed with United Peoples’ Front [UPF]
and Kuki National Organization [KNO] of Manipur on 04.09.2025,
which is valid upto 03.09.2026.

7.    Vide MHA’s Notification dated 26.09.2025, 9 districts and
21 Police Stations in 5 other districts of Nagaland, entire State of
Manipur excluding the areas falling under the jurisdiction of 13
Police Stations of 5 districts and Tirap, Changland and Longding
districts & the areas of 3 Police Stations in Namsai districts of
Arunachal Pradesh have been declared as ‘disturbed area’ under
Section 3 of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 (AFSPA)
for a further period of six(6) months w.e.f. 01.10.2025. The
Government of Assam declared 3 districts (Tinsukia, Charaideo &
Sivasagar) as ‘disturbed area’ under AFSPA for a further period of
six (6) months w.e.f. 01.10.2025 vide Notification dated
27.09.2025.

8.   The National Socialist Council of Nagaland (Khaplang)
[NSCN(K)] has been declared as ‘unlawful association’ for a
further period of 5 years w.e.f. 28.09.2025 under the provisions
of Section 3 of the UAPA, 1968 vide MHA’s Notification No.
4241(E) dated 22.09.2025.
9.   Ceasefire Agreement with the National Socialist Council of
Nagaland (Khaplang) NSCN(K) Nikki) has been extended for a
further period of one year w.e.f. 08.09.2025 i.e. upto 07.09.2026.

10. Ministry of Home Affairs has conveyed administrative
approval and expenditure sanction for construction of 15 new
building projects, approved under the Umbrella Scheme of Police
Infrastructure.

11. Following meetings were held under the Chairmanship of
Union Home Secretary: -

       (i)     Meeting for Sub-Committee of National Executive
               committee (SC-NEC) on 09.09.2025 to consider the
               National Project for Strengthening Community Based
               Disaster Risk Reduction Initiatives in Panchayati Raj
               and the proposals of Expansion & Modernization of
               Fire Services for the states of Haryana, Madhya
               Pradesh and Rajasthan.
       (ii)    Meeting with all the stakeholders to review the status
               of technological      solutions, i.e. Comprehensive
               Integrated Border Management System (CIBMS) in UT
               of Jammu and Kashmir along Indo-Pakistan Border on
               15.09.2025.
       (iii)   Meeting of the Multi Stakeholder to discuss the issues
               related to ‘increasing trend of natural disasters events
               in    Hill States of Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal
               Pradesh &        Uttarakhand and on 23.09.2025.
       (iv)    Review of Model Home Guards Bill and Civil Defence
               Act/Rules and meeting for project proposal on Fire
               Dashboard on 26.09.2025.

12. Following Notifications were issued for delegation of powers
to the Administrator (whether known as the Lieutenant Governor
or the Governor or the Administrator) of the Union territories:

 i.    S.O. no. 4430(E) dated 29.09.2025 under The Factories act,
       1948 (63 of 1948).
ii.    S.O. no. 4431(E) Dated 29.09.2025 under The Industrial
       Dispute Act, 1947 (14 of 1947).
iii.   S.O. no. 4432(E) Dated 29.09.2025 under The Contract
       Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 (37 of 1970).
iv.    S.O. no. 4433(E) Dated 29.09.2025 under The Minimum
       Wages Act, 1948 (11 of 1948).
 v.    S.O. no. 4433(E) Dated 29.09.2025 under The Motor
       Transport Workers Act, 1961 (27 of 1961).


13. The    following  sub-ordinate legislation under    the
Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025 have been notified on
01.09.2025 and 02.09.2025: -
   i.   The Immigration and Foreigners Rules, 2025
  ii.   The Immigration and Foreigners Order, 2025.
 iii.   The Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order,
        2025
 iv.    The notification delegating certain powers and
        functions to the State Government, Union Territories
        etc.
  v.    The notification on compounding of certain offenses
 vi.    The notification notifying the designated immigration
        posts
vii.    The notification authorizing Superintendent of Police
        or Deputy Commissioner of Police in each District as
        Registration Officers
viii.   The notification appointing the Superintendent of
        Police or Deputy Commissioner of Police in each
        District as civil authorities
 ix.    The notification appointing Foreigners Regional
        Registration Officers as civil authorities
  x.    The notification authorizing Foreigners Regional
        Registration Officers as Registration Officers

सितंबर, 2025 माह के सिए गृह मंत्रािय की प्रमुख उपिब्धियां , महत्वपूर्ण घटनाक्रम और मुख्य
कायणक्रम।

      भारत के माननीय राष्ट्रपतत ने तिनाां क 08.09.2025 को "तिमाचल प्रिे श लोकतांत्र प्रिरी सम्मान
(तनरसन) तिधेयक, 2023" को स्वीकृतत िी।

2.    भारत के माननीय राष्ट्रपतत ने तिनाां क 23.09.2025 को “कारखाना (उत्तर प्रिे श सांशोधन)
तिधेयक, 2024” को स्वीकृतत िी।

3.    “औद्योतिक तििाि (तत्रपुरा तीसरा सां शोधन) अध्यािे श, 2025” को प्रख्यातपत करने सांबांधी
माननीय राष्ट्रपतत के अनुिेश तिनाां क 30.09.2025 को तिए िए।

4.      िृि सतचि ने तिनाां क 26.09.2025 को िोिा के तलए नए आपरातधक कानूनोां के कायाा न्वयन की
समीक्षा की।

5.    िृि सतचि ने 10 उच्च न्यायालयोां - इलािाबाि, बॉम्बे , कनाा टक, केरल, तबिार, पांजाब और
िररयाणा, तिल्ली, राजस्थान, तेलांिाना और ओतिशा के मिापांजीयकोां के साथ बैठकें आयोतजत कीां।

6.          मतणपुर के कुकी नेशनल ऑिानाइजेशन [केएनओ] के साथ सां शोतधत आधारभू त तनयमािली
पर तत्रपक्षीय ऑपरे शन तनलांबन (एसओओ) समझौते पर तिनाां क 04.09.2025 को यूनाइटे ि पीपुल्स
फ्रांट [यू पीएफ] और िस्ताक्षर तकए िए, जो तिनाां क 03.09.2026 तक िैध िै ।


7.        िृि मांत्रालय की तिनाां क 26.09.2025 की अतधसूचना के तित, नािालैंि के 9 तजलोां और 5
अन्य तजलोां के 21 पुतलस थानोां, पूरे मतणपुर राज्य, तजसमें 5 तजलोां के 13 पुतलस थाने और ततरप,
चाां िलैंि और लोांितिां ि तजलोां के अतधकार क्षेत्र में आने िाले क्षेत्र शातमल निीां िैं और अरुणाचल प्रिे श
के नामसाई तजलोां के 3 पु तलस थानोां के क्षेत्रोां को सशस्त्र बल (तिशेष शक्तियाां ) अतधतनयम, 1958
(एएफएसपीए) की धारा 3 के अांतिात तिनाां क 01.10.2025 से छः (6) मिीने की अततररि अितध के
तलए 'अशाां त क्षेत्र' घोतषत तकया िया िै । असम सरकार ने तिनाां क 27.09.2025 की अतधसूचना के तित
तिनाां क 01.10.2025 से छः (6) मिीने की अततररि अितध के तलए एएफएसपीए के अांतिात 3 तजलोां
(ततनसुतकया, चराइिे ि और तशिसािर) को 'अशाां त क्षेत्र' घोतषत तकया िै ।


8.      नेशनल सोशतलस्ट काउां तसल ऑफ नािालैंि (खापलाां ि) [एनएससीएन (के)] को िृि मांत्रालय
के तिनाां क 22.09.2025 की अतधसूचना सांख्या 4241 (अ) के तित यूएपीए, 1968 की धारा 3 के
प्रािधानोां के अधीन तिनाां क 28.09.2025 से 5 िषों की अततररि अितध के तलए 'तितध-तिरूद्ध
सांिठन' घोतषत तकया िया िै ।

9.       नेशनल सोशतलस्ट काउां तसल ऑफ नािालैंि (खापलाां ि) [एनएससीएन (के)] (तनक्की) के साथ
युद्धतिराम समझौते को तिनाां क 08.09.2025 से एक िषा की अितध के तलए अथाा त 07.09.2026 तक
बढा तिया िया िै ।

10.   िृि मांत्रालय ने पुतलस अिसांरचना की अम्ब्रेला योजना के अांतिात स्वीकृत 15 नई भिन
पररयोजनाओां के तनमाा ण के तलए सक्षम प्रातधकारी का प्रशासतनक अनुमोिन और व्यय स्वीकृतत प्रिान
कर िी िै ।
11.    केंद्रीय िृि सतचि की अध्यक्षता में तनम्नतलक्तखत बैठकें आयोतजत की िईां: -

           i.   पांचायती राज में समुिाय आधाररत आपिा जोक्तखम न्यूनीकरण पिलोां को सुदृढता
                प्रिान करने के तलए राष्ट्रीय पररयोजना तथा िररयाणा, मध्य प्रिे श और राजस्थान राज्योां
                के तलए अतिशमन सेिाओां के तिस्तार एिां आधुतनकीकरण के प्रस्तािोां पर तिचार करने
                के तलए तिनाां क 09.09.2025 को राष्ट्रीय कायाकारी सतमतत की उप-सतमतत (एससी-
                एनईसी) की बैठक।
          ii.   जम्मू और कश्मीर सांघ राज्य क्षेत्र में भारत-पातकस्तान सीमा पर प्रौद्योतिकीय समाधान,
                अथाा त- व्यापक एकीकृत सीमा प्रबांधन प्रणाली (सीआईबीएमएस) की क्तस्थतत की
                समीक्षा के तलए तिनाां क 15.09.2025 को सभी तितधारकोां के साथ बैठक।
         iii.   जम्मू और कश्मीर, तिमाचल प्रिे श तथा उत्तराखांि जैसे पिातीय राज्योां में प्राकृततक
                आपिाओां की बढती आिृतत्त से सां बांतधत मुद्ोां पर चचाा करने के तलए तिनाां क
                23.09.2025 को बहु-तितधारकोां की बैठक।
         iv.    तिनाां क 26.09.2025 को आिशा िोम िािडा स तिधेयक एिां तसतिल सु रक्षा
                अतधतनयम/तनयमोां की समीक्षा एिां फायर िै शबोिा पर पररयोजना प्रस्ताि िे तु बैठक।

12.   सांघ राज्य क्षेत्रोां के प्रशासक (चािे उन्हें उप-राज्यपाल या राज्यपाल या प्रशासक के रूप में
जाना जाए) को शक्तियोां के प्रत्यायोजन के तलए तनम्नतलक्तखत अतधसूचनाएां जारी की िईां:

           i.   का.आ. 4430(अ) तिनाां क 29.09.2025 कारखाना अतधतनयम, 1948 (1948 का 63)
                के तित।
          ii.   का.आ. 4431(अ) तिनाां क 29.09.2025 औद्योतिक तििाि अतधतनयम, 1947 (1947
                का 14) के तित।
         iii.   का.आ. 4432(अ) तिनाां क 29.09.2025 ठे का श्रम (तितनयमन और उत्सािन)
                अतधतनयम, 1970 (1970 का 37) के तित।
         iv.    का.आ. 4433(अ) तिनाां क 29.09.2025 न्यूनतम मजिू री अतधतनयम, 1948 (1948 का
                11) के तित।
          v.    का.आ. 4434(अ) तिनाां क 29.09.2025 मोटर पररििन कमाकार अतधतनयम, 1961
                (1961 का 27) के तित।

13.    आव्रजन और तििे शी अतधतनयम, 2025 के अांतिात तनम्नतलक्तखत अधीनस्थ कानून तिनाां क
01.09.2025 और 02.09.2025 को अतधसूतचत तकए िए िैं : -

           i.   आव्रजन और तििे शी तिषयक तनयमािली, 2025
          ii.   आव्रजन और तििे शी तिषयक आिे श, 2025
         iii.   आव्रजन और तििे शी तिषयक (छूट) आिे श, 2025
         iv.    राज्य सरकार, सांघ राज्य क्षेत्र आति को कुछ शक्तियाां और काया प्रत्यायोतजत करने
                िाली अतधसूचना।
          v.    कुछ अपराधोां के शमन पर अतधसूचना
         vi.    नातमत आव्रजन चौतकयोां को अतधसूतचत करने िाली अतधसूचना
        vii.    प्रत्येक तजले में पुतलस अधीक्षक या पुतलस उपायुि को पांजीकरण अतधकारी के रूप
                में प्रातधकृत करने िाली अतधसूचना
       viii.    प्रत्येक तजले में पुतलस अधीक्षक या पुतलस उपायुि को तसतिल प्रातधकारी के रूप में
                तनयुि करने सांबांधी अतधसू चना
         ix.    तििे शी तिषयक क्षेत्रीय पांजीकरण अतधकाररयोां को तसतिल प्रातधकारी के रूप में
                तनयुि करने सांबांधी अतधसू चना
          x.    तििे शी तिषयक क्षेत्रीय पां जीकरण अतधकाररयोां को पांजीकरण अतधकारी के रूप में
                प्रातधकृत करने िाली अतधसूचना

docs.title: Monthly Major Achievements of MHA, August 2025
pages:
Major Achievements, significant Development and important
events of Ministry of Home Affairs for the month of August,
2025.

     The Hon’ble President of India assented to the 'The Factories
(Jharkhand Amendment) Bill, 2025’ on 01.08.2025.

2. The Hon’ble President of India assented to the ‘The Aparna
Institution (Taking over of Management and Control) Bill, 2025’
on 27.08.2025.

3.   Hon’ble Union Home Minister reviewed the implementation
of New Criminal Laws on 01.08.2025.

4.   The Home Secretary reviewed the implementation of New
Criminal Laws for the Odisha on 18.08.2025, and Andhra
Pradesh on 20.08.2025.

5.   The Home Secretary convened physical visits and reviews of
NCL in Punjab on 22.08.2025 and in Himachal Pradesh on
23.08.2025.

6.   A meeting of Consultative Committee of Home Affairs on
Disaster Management was held on 09.08.2025 under the
chairmanship of Hon'ble Home Minister.

7. Following meeting were held under the Chairmanship of Union
Home Secretary:-

     (a). Meeting for Sub-Committee of National Executive
     Committee (SC-NEC) on 07.08.2025 to consider the Central
     financial assistance for State of Assam, Meghalaya and
     Kerala, from Recovery & Reconstruction Funding Window
     under National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF).

     (b). Meeting of SC-NEC on 13.08.2025 to consider the report
     of IMCT on damage caused by flood, landslides of 2024 in
     Assam and Gujarat.

     (c). Review Meeting for the Mitigation Project on Lightening
     Safety (MPLS) on 18.08.2025 .

8. Meeting between Home Secretary and British High
Commissioner to India was held on 12.08.2025 at New Delhi.

9. Notification for delegation of powers under the Prison Act,
1894 (9 of 11894) to the Administrator of the UT of Chandigarh
vide S.O. 3674(E) dated 12.08.2025.
10. Notification for delegation of power under sub-section (4) lof
section 15 of the Mines and Minerals (Development and
Regulation) Act, 1957 (67 of 1957) to the Administrator
(Lieutenant Governor) of the UT of Puducherry. vide S.O. 3673
(E) dated 12.08.2025.

11. Notification regarding extension of the Haryana Backward
Classes (Reservation in Services and Admission in Educational
Institues) Act, 2016 to the UT of Chandigarh has been published
in Gazette of India (Extraordinary) vide S.O. 3598 (E) dated
05.08.2025.

12. Ministry of Home Affairs has conveyed approval of the
competent authority for creation of 82 posts in Delhi Police for
new judicial lock-up at District Courts, Rouse Avenue, New Delhi.

13. A meeting was held under the chairmanship of Union Home
Secretary on 21.08.2025 to discuss the report submitted by High
Power Committee (HPC) on projected requirement for formulation
of Modernization Plan-V of CAPFs.

14. A meeting was held under the chairmanship of Additional
Secretary (PM) on 26.08.2025 to discuss the items proposed
under Modernization Plan-V.

15. A meeting was held under the chairmanship of Union Home
Secretary on 29.08.2025 to discuss the possibilities of
development of technological innovation for CAPFs Modernization
Plan through an alternative platform.

16. HPC meeting was held under the chairmanship of AS (PM)
on 27.08.2025 for considering of State/UTs action plan of Bihar,
Goa and Delhi.

17. PSARA RANKINGS:- MHA has developed a criterion for
deciding ranking of States/UTs based on their monthly
performance to motivate the States. The top 5 States /UTs during
the month of August, 2025 are Himachal Pradesh, Telangana,
Haryana, Kerala and Nagaland. The complete ranking of States
and UTs are available on the portal www.psara.gov.in.

18. 1090 Personnel of Police, Fire, Home Guard & Civil Defence
and Correctional Services were awarded Gallantry/Service
Medals on the occasion of the Independence Day- 2025.

                              *****
अगस्त 2025 माह के लिए गृह मंत्रािय की प्रमुख उपिब्धियां, महत्वपूर्ण
घटनाक्रम और कायणक्रम।

      दिन ां क 01.08.2025 को भ रत की म ननीय र ष्ट्रपदत ने 'ि फैक्ट्र ीज (झ रखांड
सांशोधन) दिधेयक, 2025' को अपनी स्वीकृदत प्रि न की।

2.    दिन ां क 27.08.2025 को भ रत की म ननीय र ष्ट्रपदत ने 'अपर् ा इां स्टीट्यूशन
(मैनेजमेंट और कांटर ोल क अदधक र लेन ) दिधेयक, 2025' को स्वीकृदत प्रि न की।

3.      दिन ां क 01.08.2025 को म ननीय केंद्रीय गृह मांत्री ने नए आपर दधक क नूनोां के
क य ा न्वयन की समीक्ष की।

4.         गृह सदिि ने दिन ां क 18.08.2025 को ओदडश और दिन ां क 20.08.2025 को
आां ध्र प्रिे श में नए आपर दधक क नूनोां के क य ा न्वयन की समीक्ष की।

5.   गृह सदिि ने दिन ां क 22.08.2025 को पांज ब और दिन ां क 23.08.2025 को
दहम िल प्रिे श में िौर दकय और एनसीएल की समीक्ष की।

6.       दिन ां क 09.08.2025 को म ननीय गृह मांत्री की अध्यक्षत में आपि प्रबांधन पर
गृह मांत्र लय की सल हक र सदमदत की बैठक आयोदजत हुई।

7. केंद्रीय गृह सदिि की अध्यक्षत में दनम्नदलखखत बैठकें आयोदजत हुईां:

      (क) दिन ां क 07.08.2025 को र ष्ट्रीय क याक ररर्ी सदमदत की उप-सदमदत
          (एससी-एनईसी) की बैठक, दजसमें असम, मेघ लय और केरल र ज्ोां को
          नेशनल दडज स्टर ररस्पॉन्स फांड (NDRF) की ररकिरी और पुनदनाम ा र्
          फांदडां ग दिांडो से केंद्रीय दित्तीय सह यत पर दिि र दकय गय ।

      (ख) दिन ां क 13.08.2025 को एससी-एनईसी की बैठक, दजसमें असम और
          गुजर त में िर्ा 2024 में ब ढ़ और भूस्खलन से हुए नुकस न पर
          आईएमसीटी की ररपोटा पर दिि र दकय गय ।

      (ग) दिन ां क 18.08.2025 को ल इटदनांग सेफ्टी पर दमदटगेशन प्रोजेक्ट्
          (एमपीएलएस) की समीक्ष बैठक।

8.     दिन ां क 12.08.2025 को गृह सदिि और भ रत में दिदटश उच्च युक्त के बीि नई
दिल्ली में बैठक हुई।

9.       दिन ां क 12.08.2025 के एस.ओ. 3674(ई) के म ध्यम से, जेल अदधदनयम, 1894
(11894 क 9) के तहत िांडीगढ़ सांघ र ज् क्षेत्र के प्रश सक को शखक्तयोां क
प्रत्य योजन करने के दलए अदधसूिन ज री की गई।
10. दिन ां क 12.08.2025 के स .आ. 3673 (ई) के म ध्यम से ख न और खदनज
(दिक स और दिदनयमन) अदधदनयम, 1957 (1957 क अदधदनयम 67) की ध र 15 की
उप-ध र (4) के तहत पुिुिेरी सांघ र ज् क्षेत्र के प्रश सक (उपर ज्प ल) को शखक्तयोां
के प्रत्य योजन के सांबांध में अदधसूिन ।

11. दिन ां क 05.08.2025 के स .आ. 3598 (ई) के म ध्यम से हररय र् दपछड िगा
(सेि ओां में आरक्षर् और शैक्षदर्क सांस्थ नोां में प्रिेश) अदधदनयम, 2016 को िांडीगढ़
सांघ र ज् क्षेत्र में ल गू करने के सांबांध में अदधसूिन भ रत के र जपत्र (अस ध रर्) में
प्रक दशत की गई ।

12. गृह मांत्र लय ने नई दिल्ली, र उज एिेन्यू खस्थत दजल न्य य लय में नए न्य दयक
लॉक-अप के दलए दिल्ली पुदलस में 82 पिोां के सृजन के दलए सक्षम प्र दधक री की
स्वीकृदत प्रि न की ।

13. दिन ां क 21.08.2025 को केंद्रीय गृह सदिि की अध्यक्षत में एक बैठक
आयोदजत की गई। इस बैठक में सीएपीएफ के आधुदनकीकरर् योजन -V के निरूपण
दलए अनुम दनत आिश्यकत पर उच्च दधक र प्र प्त सदमदत (एिपीसी) द्व र प्रस्तुत
ररपोटा पर िि ा की गई।

14. दिन ां क 26.08.2025 को अपर सदिि (पीएम) की अध्यक्षत में आधुदनकीकरर्
योजन -V के तहत प्रस्त दित मिोां पर िि ा के दलए एक बैठक आयोदजत की गई।

15. दिन ां क 29.08.2025 को केंद्रीय गृह सदिि की अध्यक्षत में एक बैठक हुई,
दजसमें िैकखिक प्लेटफॉमा के म ध्यम से सीएपीएफ के आधुदनकीकरर् की योजन के
दलए तकनीकी नि ि र के दिक स की सांभ िन ओां पर िि ा की गई।

16. दिन ां क 27.08.2025 को अपर सदिि (पीएम) की अध्यक्षत में दबह र, गोि और
दिल्ली र ज्ोां/सांघ र ज् क्षेत्रोां की क या योजन पर दिि र करने के दलए उच्च दधक र
प्र प्त सदमदत की बैठक आयोदजत की गई।

17. पीएसएआरए रैं लकंग:- र ज्ोां को प्रोत्स दहत करने के दलए, गृह मांत्र लय ने
उनके म दसक प्रिशान के आध र पर र ज्ोां/सां घ र ज् क्षेत्रोां की रैं दकांग तय करने क एक
म निां ड बन य है । अगस्त 2025 में शीर्ा 5 र ज्/सांघ र ज् क्षेत्र दहम िल प्रिे श,
तेलांग न , हररय र् , केरल और न ग लैंड हैं । सभी र ज्ोां और सांघ र ज् क्षेत्रोां की पूरी
रैं दकांग www.psara.gov.in पोटा ल पर उपलब्ध है ।

18. स्वतांत्रत दििस-2025 के अिसर पर पुदलस, फ यर, होम ग डा और दसदिल
दडफेंस तथ सुध र सेि ओां के 1090 कदमायोां को बह िु री/सेि पिक से सम्म दनत दकय
गय ।
